title: Forest Hearth Sauna
subtitle: A winter forest sauna retreat for tactile knitwear.
line: A sanctuary of knitted warmth nestled in the frost of a winter forest.
quote: Where the sharp bite of winter meets the soft embrace of the hearth.
synopsis: You step into a hushed winter sanctuary, where the scent of wood and the haze of steam envelop you in warmth. At the heart of the space, the Central steam sauna stove acts as your first anchor, radiating a soft, golden light. As you circle this glowing center, you find yourself drawn to the clay-hewn shelves that display delicate knitwear like treasures. Finally, you reach the wooden counter at the back, leaving the frozen world far behind.

why.d: Shelf walls (Knitted wool displays) wrap the left, right and back of the 8 x 10 m room. The clay shelves create a sensory contrast to the soft knitwear, inviting you to touch and feel each garment.
The centre object (Central steam sauna stove) is the first stop, 4.2 m in from the door. The central wooden stove grounds you, offering a warm visual focal point in the misty, steam-filled room.
The route circles it first, then follows the shelves. The circular journey forces you to slow down, encouraging a deliberate and meditative exploration of the collection.
The counter (Checkout counter) sits at the back, off the loop. The wooden counter at the back provides a final moment of organic connection before you conclude your journey.

materials.name: Charred Cedar Wood
materials.where: floor, ceiling, central steam sauna stove, checkout counter

stops.cap: I stand before the steaming stove, feeling the sudden warmth of the hearth.
stops.sub: The centerpiece of the forest sauna radiates a gentle, golden light.

stops.cap: I trace the rough texture of the clay shelves, admiring the delicate wool
stops.sub: Layers of clay hold the soft garments like protected artifacts.

stops.cap: Looking up, I lose my gaze in the thick, swirling steam of the sauna zone.
stops.sub: The room dissolves into an ethereal, misty white dream.
